text:
Mia Chen: Quick sync — we need a lightweight playbook for the webinar lead flow: post-webinar landing, canonical mapping, redirect hygiene, JSON-LD for event/schema, and internal link stitching. timeline: launch day +48h QA.

Raj Patel: +1. do we prefer in-place canonical or redirect back to new landing?

Mia Chen: Redirects for old promo pages -> canonical landing (permanent) to consolidate signals. keep canonical on the new landing.

Olivia Park: I can own the internal linking plan (header CTAs, related resources, blog mentions). will draft anchor list by EOD.

Sam R.: I'll handle redirect rules with eng; need the exact old paths and any query param preservation rules. also want a brief nginx snippet to hand off.

Mia Chen: Old paths: /events/old-webinar, /resources/webinar-preview, /blog/what-to-expect-webinar. preserve utm_* and gclid where present.

Sam R.: draft rewrite for eng: ```location /events/old-webinar { return 301 $scheme://$host/webinar-2026$request_uri; } # preserve query string by default in our setup```

Raj Patel: For wildcard mapping: ```rewrite ^/resources/webinar-preview(.*)$ /webinar-2026$1 permanent;``` will that work for subpaths?

Sam R.: yep, that covers subpaths. will add rule to drop legacy tracking params we no longer honor, but keep utm_source/utm_campaign.

schema-bot: Suggested JSON-LD for the event (trimmed) — use on the landing only: ```{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Live: Serving at Scale","startDate":"2026-05-12T10:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.inference/webinar-2026","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}```

Alex (growth): Copy ask: CTA copy variants for A/B: "Watch the demo" vs "See cost & latency benchmarks". We'll route 60/40 to benchmark messaging.

Olivia Park: Internal links list: 1) benchmarks -> /benchmarks 2) docs/price-optimization -> /optimize 3) blog post on canaries -> /blog/canary-deploys. will include anchor text mapping.

Mia Chen: QA checklist (post-launch +48h): crawl old URLs -> expect 301, check canonical on new landing, validate JSON-LD with rich results test, audit internal link CTAs, confirm GA/UTM capture on lead form.

Raj Patel: I'll run a quick Screaming Frog pass and send CSV.

Sam R.: Eng will deploy redirects to staging tomorrow morning. tag me in PR.

Mia Chen: Perfect. owners: redirects=Sam, internal links=Olivia, schema validation=Raj, GTM/UTM capture=Alex. We'll reconvene in channel after staging deploy. :spiral_calendar: :+1:

Alex (growth): looping in ops-team for monitoring alerts on spike in 404s after the switch.

Olivia Park: Draft anchor/to-be-linked mapping uploaded to the content drive — ping me if you need edit access.

Mia Chen: Thanks team — threading this into launch checklist. finishing notes: keep redirect TTLs permanent (301), but hold off on canonical sweeps until 72h after launch in case we need quick rollback.

Sam R.: noted. I'll include rollback steps in the PR (revert rules + clear cache). :ok_hand:
